jj_configurations.rule: Lambda^n of the spinor level L, n = 0, ..., dim L: chi = e_n(g), n e_n = sum_{k=1}^{n} (-1)^(k-1) e_(n-k) chi_L(g^k); Lambda^(d-n)(L) = Lambda^n(L) (x) Lambda^d(L)

cases.vectors: mu = 1: |j,m_1>; mu = 2: c |j,-m_1>, c a root of unity (the partner law)
|j,m> + s |j,-m>: s = +1 and s = -1 for the flip (C_2x, 0), s = +i and s = -i for the flip (sigma_v(xz), 0)

closed_form.parity_rule: D^(j,-1)|2G = (D^(j,+1)|2G) (x) det: at parity -1 a block keeps its kets and its label is multiplied by det (parity_label_map); inside a 2-dimensional block the partner order and c are set again at that parity
closed_form.structure_theorem: A = 2G n 2C_infh acts diagonally on |j,m>; either 2G = A (abelian) or [2G:A] = 2 with the coset generated by one flip (the field flip: the lift (C_2x, 0) or (sigma_v(xz), 0)) sending |j,m> to a multiple of |j,-m>
